name: Increase Ground Item Label Cap to 64
description: Raises both synchronized ground-item label collections from 32 to 64 entries.

patches.description: Move the 0x144-byte label-record truncation endpoint from 32 entries to 64 entries
Grow the label-record collection to 64 entries instead of 32
Enter layout-list normalization for source counts of 64 or more
Compare the current layout-list count with 64
Stop growing the layout list when it reaches 64 entries
Stop shrinking the bounded layout list when it reaches 64 entries
